newsitem.title: USA: Bayer to use Genetics Institute platform.
newsitem.headline: Bayer to use Genetics Institute platform.

text.p: Genetics Institute Inc said Friday Bayer Corp has signed on as a corporate participant in GI's program for therapeutic discovery called the DiscoverEase protein development platform.

This agreement gives Bayer access to the American Home Products Corp subsidiary's library of expressed, novel, human, secreted proteins and corresponding database of information for the identification and development of novel human therapeutics.
The DiscoverEase protein development platform represents GI's functional genomics initiative to isolate and express a comprehensive library of novel human secreted proteins.
The program was launched in September 1996 and has four existing participants: Chiron Corp, Genentech Inc, Kirin Brewery Co Ltd and Ontogeny Inc.
Bayer Corp, with headquarters in Pittsburgh, is a member of the worldwide Bayer Group.
